notes.title: Trail of the Wretched is OUT!
notes.content:
[h1][b]The day is upon us.[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Trail of the Wretched has been released.[/b][/h3]

And it's free! Two hours of mind-bending and soul-crushing story telling right at your fingertips.

There's an entire world just waiting to be explored. Jump in and become the photographer you were meant to be. 

But most importantly, have fun!
